messages.content: You are a skeptical senior area chair and world-model security researcher. Return valid JSON only.

We are trying to finish an ICLR-scale world-model security paper. Be a skeptical senior area chair and mechanism designer. Return strict JSON only.

Available executable carriers in the repository: (1) MBRL-Lib GaussianMLP ensembles with native ModelEnv + CEM on CartPole, HalfCheetah, Pusher; (2) official TD-MPC2 mt30-48M with native MPPI/MPC on walker/cheetah/hopper/cup tasks; (3) released WorldAgen/LIBERO visual world model with a short causal-backbone adaptation probe, but the referenced full TTT script is missing. Attacker may only execute legal simulator actions and submit true observations/rewards; no edited samples, labels, weights, planner code, or attacker-authored text. We can run short CPU/GPU gates, but not long experiments before a candidate is supported.

Already rejected or bounded: ordinary data/replay poisoning, cross-task negative transfer, trajectory order imprinting, latent geometry/Jacobian/non-normality, SimNorm/uncertainty collapse, Q-only/value provenance, actor/full-update effects, gradient attacks, rollout compounding, branch/counterfactual coupling in pointwise TD-MPC2, query/memory contamination, truncation bias, CEM covariance/ordinary correlated sampling, and generic POMDP state aliasing. A mathematically exact rank-coupling sampler on MBRL-Lib CartPole preserves every candidate's marginal forecast law while changing joint coupling and causes 4/4 short paired declines (mean 97 vs 180), but stronger HalfCheetah/Pusher and TD-MPC2 gates failed; bank-mean defense restores two fresh seeds to 200/200. Do not simply rename this or claim cross-task support.

Task: propose at most three genuinely distinct, executable security operations that could plausibly reach conceptual novelty 7-7.5 and a broad one-sentence claim with explicit qualifiers. Each must be a legal action-only operation, map to an available carrier, state an invariant that ordinary validation would preserve, name closest primary prior-art overlap, and specify a decisive <=2 minute native falsification gate with positive/negative controls and a useful defense. Reject anything that is merely generic poisoning, distribution shift, state aliasing, uncertainty/representation drift, sampling variance, or unavailable architecture. Prefer a mechanism involving a planning protocol or learning/update semantics that existing carriers actually implement. Include a recommendation field: RUN_ONE, RUN_SEVERAL, or STOP. JSON keys: candidates (list), recommendation, ordering, why_previous_routes_closed, exact_first_experiment.
